summary.text: Mary Shannon Lindstrom is an independent candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 124, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a member of the Scarborough School Board and has worked in the credit union movement.

paragraphs.text: Lindstrom earned a high school diploma from Winter Park High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Central Florida in 2001 and a graduate degree from George Mason University in 2003.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as self-employed.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she lives in Scarborough with her husband, Jason, and their four boys, and volunteers with Scarborough Community Services and Maine Medical Center.
Lindstrom is running in a race with no incumbent against Democrat Eric Nathanson and Republican Scott Doherty.

In her survey responses, she described consensus building as central to her leadership and said she supports exploring new revenue tools that would reduce municipalities' reliance on property taxes, including a local option sales tax on tourism-related purchases.
She also named education, services for seniors, healthcare, consumer protection and reasonable banking policy as areas of public policy she cares about.
